_comment: STUB — apps/command-center/ has been extracted to the standalone repo
The Vercel project rooted here predates the extraction. Updating its
Root Directory in project settings requires dashboard access; this
stub achieves the same result from code: the directory exists (so
Vercel's clone-validation passes), and ignoreCommand returns 0 so the
build is skipped with a clean 'Skipped' status instead of 'Error'.
The real Command Center deploys continue on a separate Vercel project
ignoreCommand: echo 'apps/command-center extracted to CC90210/oasis-command-center; skipping build' && exit 0
